europe_now.title: Ceuta has 're-exposed immigration's divisive nature' in the EU
europe_now.summary: The EU has highlighted the ongoing migration crisis at Ceuta, a Spanish enclave on the North African coast. The situation has prompted discussions about the EU's immigration policies and the need for solidarity among member states.

sources.headline: Ceuta has 're-exposed immigration's divisive nature' in the EU

europe_now.title: Ukraine live: Russian strikes kill at least 15 in Kyiv and surrounding region
